title: Paloma and the Debt
author: Dominic Ravensworth
blurb: Odile Winterbourne, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
